intro: Cuba's state-run economy relies on tourism, nickel, tobacco and doctors sent abroad.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Cuban cigars and rum are famous. Nickel is a big export. Cuba sends doctors to many countries in exchange for payment.

chapters.title: Crisis
text: Since 2020 fuel shortages and blackouts have been severe.

cardGroups.title: Made in Cuba
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Cuba makes and sells to the world.
